demo.title: bazaar.mjs
demo.code:
# Every call goes through one dependency-free Node script; each answer carries replyText
node scripts/bazaar.mjs markets --sort trending --limit 5

# One market card from a pasted link: odds beside the pool, who settles it and their record
node scripts/bazaar.mjs lookup --ref https://bazaar.playhunch.xyz/markets/<id>

# Store HUNCH_BANKR_API_KEY privately in Bankr Env Vars; the script verifies the wallet via /wallet/me
# Quote, then bet: the x402 challenge is pin-checked before one authorization is signed
node scripts/bazaar.mjs quote --id <id> --outcome yes --amount 5.00
node scripts/bazaar.mjs bet --id <id> --outcome yes --amount 5.00 --idempotency-key x-<post id>

# A standing bet: $1 on YES in each new market @alice opens, up to 5 bets, for 7 days
node scripts/bazaar.mjs standing-bet-draft --json '{"scope":{"creator":"@alice"},"outcomeKey":"yes","amountPerBet":"1.00","maxTotal":"5.00","maxBets":5,"expiresIn":"7d"}'

setup: Node 18+, a Base wallet with USDC and a Bankr API key with Wallet API access; a bet is $0.50 minimum with no Hunch maximum (Bankr's own limits apply), paid to the pinned settlement address
Make a market: `@bankrbot market this: <question>`, then reply `confirm` to the preview; every write is signed with a free personal_sign wallet proof
Only the creator can resolve or void; a market unresolved 48h past its deadline refunds every bettor
Standing bets place bets inside limits the wallet signs once; event webhooks tell a wallet's own Bankr webhook when its markets close or its bets settle

Payments go to a Hunch-controlled settlement account, not rule-enforcing market escrow. Bet recording, payouts and the promised 48-hour refunds depend on the operator; a payment receipt alone does not prove them.
